original.target_description: Regression relationship between simplicity and inventory management in the German sample. Country-specific multiple regression including simplicity and discipline predictors.

n.sample_role: German manufacturing sites/respondents; exact country-specific analytic n not printed.
n.exclusions: Food and Tobacco, Chemical and Textile sectors excluded; underrepresented sectors with fewer than 30 sites excluded. Final pooled database has 485 respondents, not the country analytic n.
n.location: p. 137 (PDF p. 5), analysis exclusions and Fig. 3
n.quote: the resulting database consists of 485 individual ... respondents which represent approximately 60% of ... the original database, with a geographic split as ... shown in Fig. 3.

es.location: p. 139 (PDF p. 7), Table 6, Germany row, Inventory management column; also pp. 144–145 (PDF pp. 12–13), Appendix D, Table II

p.location: pp. 144–145 (PDF pp. 12–13), Appendix D, Table II

notes: Published article copy, 1998, pp. 133–146. Rendered PDF pp. 5, 12 and 13 inspected. Fig. 3 shows only rounded country percentages (Germany 32%, Switzerland 12%); its labels are absent from canonical TXT. No exact country-specific analytic n is established; 485 is pooled and has not been substituted. The printed R2 describes the full outcome model with both simplicity and discipline predictors; no separate R2 for only the named predictor family is printed. No omnibus model P-value is printed, so coefficient P-values are not paired with this model R2.
